name: Taos Pueblo

dates.note: The year is the style node's own ('in continuous occupation for more than six centuries'); neither the Wikipedia infobox read nor the Library's item record states a construction date, and the HABS data PDF opened is an addendum of field records with no dated description.

refs.title: Pueblo of Taos Central Portion, Taos Pueblo, Taos County, NM
refs.note: The PDF's covers print 'HABS NM-102' and the call number 'HABS NM,28-TAOP,2-'. Read three times on 4 Sep 2026 with different queries, it returned only an ADDENDUM: field records, an inventory of 1973 photogrammetric glass plates by Perry E. Borchers of Ohio State University, and a project statement naming HABS Historians Jeanne C. Lawrence (1985) and Caroline R. Alderson (1986). No written description of the buildings was found in it, so no `survey` block is recorded; the description, if one exists, is in a part of the record the extraction tier did not return.

U.S. National Register of Historic Places, designated October 15, 1966, reference no. 66000496; U.S. National Historic Landmark District, designated October 9, 1960 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)

note: Seeded 4 Sep 2026. The node names this as the Puebloan substrate and not a Spanish colonial building; the record locates it and states no measurement. HABS NM-? for the San Geronimo Mission at the pueblo (item nm0038) surfaced in the searches and is a separate record not opened.
